# Knowledge: Legacy Soap Gateway Endpoint

## Context

A partner gateway was kept alive during the migration to REST.

## Content

- The legacy SOAP gateway endpoint accepts order submissions from the partner system.
- It is retired after the REST migration and must not be used for new integrations.

## Example

Only relevant while the partner migration is in progress.
